hook: HC: move *51* IVF patients, protect *17,156* stored eggs
hook_b: HC: move *51* IVF patients, protect *17,156* stored eggs
tldr: Justice SV Sravan Kumar told health officials to form a doctors' committee to supervise Oasis IVF centres, shift 51 patients to government IVF facilities and safeguard 17,156 stored eggs, amid a police probe into alleged illegal oocyte collection.

beats.what: The HC ordered patient transfers and protection of stored eggs at Oasis IVF centres.
beats.why: The firm said patients mid-treatment would suffer if care stopped; the state said its doctors are accused in the case.
beats.care: 51 patients will continue treatment at nearby government IVF facilities under committee supervision.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI (Nov 19): the firm says it was only a custodian of the eggs; the government pleader said donors were identified and cases registered.

cards.q: What should come first in cases like this?

qs: Who is responsible for stored eggs when a clinic is under investigation?

facts.t: A related plea to club cases against another doctor is listed for *Nov 28*.

viz.verdict: Treatment continues while the probe goes on

steps.e: Doctors' panel to supervise Oasis IVF centres
Shift to nearby govt IVF facilities

learn.t: Oocyte = a human egg cell, stored frozen for IVF

watch: Counter-affidavits in two weeks; the related plea on Nov 28.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Shift 51 IVF patients, protect 17,156 eggs at Oasis centres, Telangana high court tells officials

fact: Telangana HC orders *17,156* stored eggs at Oasis IVF centres protected during probe
twist: The court let the police investigation continue, and told the hospital and doctors to cooperate.
